name: wechat-bot
description: WeCom customer-service callback built with Hono

scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.test:release: REQUIRE_VERIFIED_ACCEPTANCE=1 node --experimental-strip-types scripts/check-test-markers.ts && pnpm run test:coverage && RUN_REAL_CODEX=1 pnpm run test:agent
scripts.test:deterministic: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:acceptance && pnpm run test:size && node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-concurrency=1 test/unit/*.test.ts test/integration/*.test.ts test/recovery/*.test.ts test/security/*.test.ts
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:acceptance && pnpm run test:size && node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-concurrency=1 --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include='index.ts' --test-coverage-include='src/**/*.ts' --test-coverage-include='scripts/**/*.ts' --test-coverage-exclude='dist/**' --test-coverage-exclude='test/**' --test-coverage-lines=90 --test-coverage-branches=80 --test-coverage-functions=90 test/unit/*.test.ts test/integration/*.test.ts test/recovery/*.test.ts test/security/*.test.ts
